name: Credo Ventures
decision_note: Prague (and Krakow) pre-seed VC; closed the USD 88m Credo Stage 5 fund in March 2026 and invested in Supernova, Delta Green, Duvo.ai and Picogrid in 2025-2026.

evidence.quote: The fund of choice for CEE founders around the world building generational companies.

The Prague and Krakow firm, whose earliest bets include UiPath and ElevenLabs, is doubling down on pre-seed in Central and Eastern Europe and its global diaspora, with a six-partner team and a $1–5M typical cheque.
Credo Ventures has closed Credo Stage 5, an $88 million fund raised in a single closing
Mezi investory se objevuje také český fond Credo Ventures, který už do Picogridu peníze dříve posílal.
Kolo vede Index Ventures, účastní se také Credo Ventures, Northzone, Puzzle Ventures a několik známých andělů
Pražský energetický startup Delta Green získal dva miliony eur, tedy 50 milionů korun, od investorů z Credo Ventures, Tilia Impact Ventures a Purple Ventures.
The round was led by Taiwania Capital, with participation from J&T Ventures, Reflex Capital, Kaya, Credo Ventures, EQT Ventures, Wing VC and Y Combinator.

analyst_notes: Sector: Credo states it backs people rather than a thesis, so 'generalist' (stated); in practice the portfolio is technology (AI, software, energy tech, defence tech). Stage: leads pre-seed and follows on later (Supernova Series A, Picogrid follow-on); stage_focus lists the stated entry stages. Ticket USD 1-5m stated on the homepage and repeated by TNW (2026-03-23); the CVCA profile (self-reported, dated 2020-01-24) says EUR 50k-10M and AUM EUR 170M - superseded by the newer B/C sources. Capital = Credo Stage 5 (USD 88m) closed in a single closing per TNW 2026-03-23; tech.eu the same day says Credo 'announces' the fund; CzechCrunch converts it to almost CZK 1.9bn. Earlier fund: Credo Stage 4, EUR 75m (2022, not re-verified here). Investment amounts are the total round sizes (Credo's share not disclosed): Picogrid USD 45m (Credo a returning investor, round type not stated); Duvo.ai USD 15m seed led by Index Ventures (amount stated in the preceding sentence of the same Lupa article); Delta Green EUR 2m from existing investors Credo, Tilia and Purple; Supernova USD 9.2m Series A led by Taiwania (amount in the tech.eu headline). Legal: Credo Ventures a.s. (IČO 28538137, Karlovo nám. 2097/10, Praha 2) is the long-standing management company (GLEIF LEI 315700V9DQ1HLW5Z2K13, active); Credo Ventures Management II a.s. (IČO 24396893) was registered 2026-01-20 at the same address, role not confirmed (possibly the Stage 5 manager) so marked 'other'. The fund vehicles of Credo Stage 4/5 were not found in ARES (likely foreign-domiciled); not listed.
